From dbde07f06226438cd2cf1179745fa1bec5d8914a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ian Rogers <irogers@google.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 12:43:05 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] perf/x86: Fix potential bad container_of in
 intel_pmu_hw_config

Auto counter reload may have a group of events with software events
present within it. The software event PMU isn't the x86_hybrid_pmu and
a container_of operation in intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr (via the
hybrid helper) could cause out of bound memory reads. Avoid this by
guarding the call to intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr with an
is_x86_event check.

Fixes: ec980e4facef ("perf/x86/intel: Support auto counter reload")
Signed-off-by: Ian Rogers <irogers@google.com>
Signed-off-by: Peter Zijlstra (Intel) <peterz@infradead.org>
Reviewed-by: Thomas Falcon <thomas.falcon@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260312194305.1834035-1-irogers@google.com

diff --git a/arch/x86/events/intel/core.c b/arch/x86/events/intel/core.c
index 36c68210d4d2..793335c3ce78 100644
--- a/arch/x86/events/intel/core.c
+++ b/arch/x86/events/intel/core.c
@@ -4855,8 +4855,10 @@ static int intel_pmu_hw_config(struct perf_event *event)
 		intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr(leader, idx++, cause_mask);
 
 		if (leader->nr_siblings) {
-			for_each_sibling_event(sibling, leader)
-				intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr(sibling, idx++, cause_mask);
+			for_each_sibling_event(sibling, leader) {
+				if (is_x86_event(sibling))
+					intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr(sibling, idx++, cause_mask);
+			}
 		}
 
 		if (leader != event)
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File Modified: `arch/x86/events/intel/core.c`

**Change:** Added a conditional check `if (is_x86_event(sibling))` inside the `for_each_sibling_event` loop within `intel_pmu_hw_config()`, so that `intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr()` is only called for sibling events that are actual x86 hardware events. Previously, the function was called on all sibling events, including software events, which could cause invalid `container_of` operations leading to out-of-bounds memory reads.

### Relationship Between Changes

The modification ensures that when auto counter reload is configured for a group containing software events, only the x86 events (which are of the expected PMU type `x86_hybrid_pmu`) are passed to the `intel_pmu_set_acr_caused_constr()` helper. This prevents the unsafe `container_of` from being applied to software event objects, avoiding undefined behavior while preserving the intended behavior for legitimate hybrid x86 events.
